messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — we need to finalize the metrics contract for the new per-route SLO panels. Proposed base set: route.p50_latency_ms, route.p95_latency_ms, route.p99_latency_ms, route.ttft_ms, route.tokens_per_sec. Ping infra/runtime owners for feasibility.

Maria Gonzales: SG. Are we treating this as per-route only, or per-route+model? my vote: per-route default, optional model dimension for high-cardinality routes.

Jamal Okoye: Agree with per-route default. For telemetry ingest we need to know sampling expectations (e.g., 1%/10%/100%) and required labels: env, region, route_id, model_name, model_version.

Kevin Patel: Warning — model_version is high cardinality. If we expose that by default panels will explode. Suggest model_version be a filterable dropdown (not a grouping label) and we emit it as a tag on a sparse cardinality metric only when explicitly enabled.

Irina Petrov: Console/UX note: dropdown needs predictable keys. Can we standardize on label names: {env, region, route, model, model_ver}? Console will map model->model_name and model_ver->model_version.

Alex Chen: OK, standardize labels to route, model, model_version. Runtime/ingest: will you emit route as stable string (no autogenerated ids)?

Jamal Okoye: Yes — runtime will emit route (string) and route_id (uuid) for correlating events. For metric dims we'll use route (human). route_id available for logs/traces only.

Maria Gonzales: For SLO math: panels should show P50/P95/P99 latency (ms) and TTFT (ms) alongside token throughput (tokens/sec). Add a small sparklines row for 1h/6h/24h. Also include a simple error budget gauge per route.

Kevin Patel: Telemetry ingest constraints: we can add route.{p50,p95,p99,ttft,tps} metrics, but for tokens/sec we'll likely compute on the backend from counters (tokens_total delta / time window). We need an ingest hook to compute per-route tokens/sec at 1m buckets.

Alex Chen: That works. Jamal — can runtime add a 1m aggregation pipeline for tokens_total with labels route+region? If not, we'll compute in Grafana but might be expensive.

Jamal Okoye: I'll prototype an aggregation task. If we do server-side rollups we can emit route.tokens_per_sec as a derived metric. Prototype by EOD Thursday.

Irina Petrov: UX: Console wants an A/B for how panels surface rollouts. Two options: 1) single SLO panel with a top-level model selector + fallback info, 2) per-model stacked panels. Need product sign-off.

Maria Gonzales: Product prefers option 1 for compactness, with a clear "model in view" label and quick switcher. Also want a canary flag in the panel when route is on canary routing.

Kevin Patel: Quotas note: some customers want per-route token quotas. Need linkage between quota metadata and the SLO dashboard so console can show remaining quota. That requires an API from billing/quotas to attach metadata to route labels.

Alex Chen: Action items: Jamal -> prototype tokens/sec rollup by Thu EOD (PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/432). Kevin -> confirm memory/cost for rollups by Fri. Irina -> UX mockups for option 1 by next Wed. Maria -> compile SLO panel spec and wire to alerts. I'll own the final contract doc.

console-bot: Added task card to eng-platform board: "SLO panels contract + rollup prototype" — https://app.tasks.internal/board/123

deploy-bot: metric-schema-v2 deployed to staging (staging.telemetry.redwood) — keep an eye on ingest spikes :eyes:

Alex Chen: Thanks all — will sync Thursday 10am if we need a quick unblock. :thumbsup:
